scope: Provisional authored-test and scaffold-handoff review only, not final bundle acceptance, product implementation acceptance, semantic red or QA.

final_verdict.summary: Reject B0 handoff: repair cleanup ownership verification, late-frame marker synchronization and exact option parsing; preserve prior evidence and renew author seal/review.

issues.finding: remember() accepts any live PID from controller metadata and registers its current start token; cleanup then signals it. Token matching guards later PID reuse but does not establish initial scratch ownership. A reviewer-owned unrelated process with no scratch-root identity was placed in metadata; the exact helpers killed it with SIGTERM.
issues.required_fix: Before registering/signalling a PID or group, independently establish its ownership by this scratch session and candidate using actual process identity/group relationships plus scratch-bound identity. Fail closed on unrelated/stale metadata. Add a live unrelated-process negative control as well as the existing legitimate cleanup and post-registration token-change controls. Do not signal the unrelated control.

issues.finding: The generated peer sends its result before atomically publishing marker. peer.finish() can therefore return before marker exists, but late-frame immediately calls marker.unlink(). An independent replay of the exact peer source confirms result_already_sent=true while marker_exists=false. A valid controller can fail with FileNotFoundError solely from scheduling.
issues.required_fix: Wait for the first correlated marker before unlinking/starting the second request; require the expected first operation identity. Add a control delaying marker publication after result delivery so this ordering remains deterministic.

issues.finding: Default argparse abbreviation accepts --chec as --check. The actual invocation reached the source-absence branch instead of rejecting the unknown selector; a future source-present run could accept the undocumented flag.
issues.required_fix: Disable option abbreviation and add a negative selector check that requires a parser diagnostic before source setup for abbreviated options.
